rules.title: Annual General Adjustment (AGA) cap of 5% (Measure BB)
rules.requirement: The Annual General Adjustment by which a landlord of a fully-covered unit may raise rent each year is set by formula tied to the Consumer Price Index, and may be no more than 5%. A landlord with banked unused AGAs from previous years may still raise rent by more than 5% to reach the rent ceiling.
rules.key_value: AGA set by CPI-linked formula, maximum 5%
rules.coverage_text: Fully-covered rental units under Berkeley's Rent Ordinance. The page lists fully covered unit types as most units in multifamily properties built before 1980, single-family homes with current tenancies that began prior to 1996, and single-family homes with five or more rooms rented out individually; new construction units (certificate of occupancy issued after 1980), most single-family homes and most condominiums are partially covered.
rules.exemptions: Partially covered units (such as new construction with certificate of occupancy issued after 1980, most single-family homes and most condominiums) are not subject to the rent ceiling. Units where the tenant shares kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord are exempt only if the landlord lived in a unit on the same property at the start of the tenancy. The cap does not prevent use of banked AGAs to raise rent to the rent ceiling.
rules.quoted_span: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.

rules.title: Capital improvement rent increase petitions limited to completed improvements
rules.requirement: Landlords may only petition for rent increases for completed capital improvements and can no longer petition for preliminary authorization of increases for planned capital improvements.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords seeking rent increases through the Rent Board petition process.
rules.quoted_span: Landlords can only file a petition for rent increases for completed capital improvements (they can no longer petition to have rent increases preliminarily authorized for planned capital improvements).

rules.title: Just cause required for eviction
rules.requirement: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance cannot be evicted unless there is just cause.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance.
rules.exemptions: Units exempt from the Rent Ordinance, including units where the tenant shares a kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord, if the landlord lived in a unit on the same property at the start of the tenancy.
rules.quoted_span: In Berkeley, tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance cannot be evicted unless there is "just cause” (previously called “good cause”).

rules.title: Minimum rental debt for nonpayment eviction
rules.requirement: A landlord may evict for nonpayment of rent only if the tenant owes rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the HUD Fair Market Rent for a unit of equivalent size in the Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR area for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.
rules.key_value: Rental debt >= one (1) month of Fair Market Rent for a unit of equivalent size
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: For a landlord to evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent, the tenant must owe an amount of rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent (FMR) value for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR as determined by the US Department of Housing and Urban Development for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.

rules.title: No eviction for failure to sign substantially similar lease
rules.requirement: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease when a fixed-term lease expires.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease upon expiration of a fixed-term lease.

rules.title: Requirements for eviction based on lease violation
rules.requirement: To evict for violating a material lease term, the term must be mutually agreed, the violation must cause substantial, actual damage to the landlord, and the landlord must show the tenant's behavior was unreasonable. The notice terminating the tenancy must clearly describe the alleged breach, and a prior notice to stop the violation must specify the lease term and describe the violation and harm.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: In any notice terminating a tenancy for a lease breach, the landlord must clearly describe the alleged breach. The landlord must demonstrate that the tenant’s behavior was unreasonable, and may not evict tenants for lease breaches that do not cause the landlord any actual harm.

rules.title: Eviction notice contents and filing with Rent Board
rules.requirement: Any notice terminating a tenancy must state that advice is available from the Rent Board and give its housing counseling phone number and website address. The landlord must file copies of termination notices, notices to quit, and summons and complaints with the Rent Board within three business days after serving the tenant.
rules.key_value: File with Rent Board within three (3) business days of service
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: Eviction notices must contain certain information directing tenants to the Rent Board, and copies of eviction notices and eviction lawsuits must be filed with the Rent Board within three business days of serving the tenant.

rules.title: Annual inflation adjustment of owner move-in relocation assistance
rules.requirement: The Rent Board must make inflationary adjustments to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts each year.
rules.coverage_text: Owner move-in evictions under Berkeley's Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Board must make inflationary adjustments to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts each year.
